text:
markdown-docx 0.3.4 syntax

Supported Markdown:
  ATX headings, paragraphs, emphasis, strong text, inline code, hard line breaks, fenced code blocks, blockquotes, ordered and unordered lists, pipe tables, links, and images.

Links use [link text](https://example.com) and become native Word hyperlinks. Labels preserve inline formatting and optional titles become tooltips. Reference links, angle-bracket autolinks, mailto links, relative file links, and linked inline images are supported wherever their content is allowed. Relative file links resolve from the output document. Destinations are not fetched. Bare URLs remain plain text. Heading bookmarks are not generated.

Lists: the first ordered marker sets the starting number, including zero. Later markers do not reset numbering. Separate lists restart independently. Nested lists have independent sequences. Indented continuation paragraphs are unnumbered and aligned with item text. Mapped list styles must reference native template numbering.

Images: alt text becomes the Word image description. Optional Markdown image titles become image titles. Standalone, inline, and linked images support both. Formatting markers in alt text are removed while their text is preserved. Empty descriptions stay empty without marking images as decorative.

Metadata comments:
  document metadata must be first
  section metadata starts a next-page section
  <!-- markdown-docx: page-break --> inserts a page break
  table metadata must immediately precede a pipe table
  image metadata must immediately precede a standalone image

Fonts: document.fonts.body and document.fonts.headings set Latin theme fonts. Mapped styles inherit from those theme slots. Omitted overrides preserve template settings. document.fonts.monospace stays explicit for code. Fonts are not embedded or installed.

Lengths use in, cm, mm, or pt. Image widths may also use percentages.

Unsupported in 0.3.4:
  empty link destinations, document-local bookmark links, raw HTML, task lists, footnotes, horizontal rules, indented code blocks, DOTX, floating images, headers and footers from Markdown, page-number fields, and direct OOXML features.

fonts.body: nonempty font name for the minor Latin theme font
fonts.headings: nonempty font name for the major Latin theme font
fonts.monospace: nonempty fixed font name for code, default Consolas
